mostWorthwhile.text: Activating the matching lymphocyte and seeing it produce both antibody-making and memory cells was most worthwhile: it connected matching an antigen to a response that can last.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and then attaching the antibodies was straightforward, though a little repetitive after the matching shapes had already been explained.

surprise.text: I did not expect one activated lymphocyte's descendants to include both antibody-making cells and memory cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt without a purpose, although the folded interiors of the antibody-making cells were shown without explanation.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: following the matching antibody through to bacteria being engulfed made me curious about other body defenses.
